note: Filed under sensory_anatomy, not eye_diameter_mm: the Methods (Somatic morphology) only list abbreviations ('ALE = anterior lateral eyes', 'AME = anterior median eyes', 'PLE = posterior lateral eyes', 'PME = posterior median eyes', 'CH = clypeus height') and the sentence is labelled 'Eyes:' with no 'diameter'. Every number in the sentence is labelled; only the number printed after this record's own label (PLE) is filed; the six interdistances and the CH values are not filed. The quote is the whole 'Eyes:' sentence, printed across a line wrap and read in two pieces and rejoined; read twice with identical values. measurement: AME 0.24 (millimetres; eye size as listed in the description), female holotype
method: measurement of the preserved holotype as listed in the species Description ('Eyes:' line); the Methods define the eye abbreviations but no eye measure
conditions: Female, holotype (the only specimen the quoted sentence can measure for this female record; the Description is of the holotype). Holotype line: 'CHINA • ♀; Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, City Nanning, Wuming County, Liangjiang Town, Daming Mountain; [23°25ʹ59ʺ N, 108°30ʹ29ʺ E]; [1250 m a.s.l.]; 26 May 2016; Y. Zhong leg.; CBEE.' No paratypes are listed. Only the female is described; no male eye sentence exists. The 'Eyes:' sentence follows 'Description' header lines of the holotype: the preceding sentence is 'MEASUREMENTS. BL 12.1; PL 5.1, PW 4.3; AW 2.6; OL 7.0, OW 4.3.' and the next sentence begins 'Spination: palp 131, 101, 2121, 1014; Fe I–, II 323, III–, IV 331; ... (cut)' The Diagnosis (one sentence, read in full in consecutive pieces) compares the epigyne with H. amphora and H. schwalbachorum and has no eye, clypeus or carapace-shape word; no sentence on the male is printed. The prosoma sentence of the Colouration paragraph reads 'Dorsal shield of prosoma reddish-brown to slightly yellowish-brown, with bright transversal crescent submarginally on posterior part, and longitudinal stripes covered by hairs around fovea.' (no eye word); the Methods print 'All measurements are given in millimetres.' and nowhere use 'diameter'. Family Sparassidae.
